cards.target: Bydd angen ymbarél arnom ni yfory.
cards.english: We will need an umbrella tomorrow.
cards.existing: `Bydd` = 'will be' (3rd person), future of `bod`. `Bydd hi'n bwrw glaw` (It'll rain). Most common future form in conversation.
